Calculate growing degree-days and cumulative thermal time

Source: R/series_time.R
pheno_thermal_time.Rd

Implements explicitly named interpretations of the growing-degree-day equation. The selected rule is returned as metadata because different threshold conventions can produce materially different totals.

Usage

pheno_thermal_time(
  data,
  tmin,
  tmax,
  base,
  upper = NULL,
  method = c("mean_clamp", "minmax_clamp"),
  by = NULL,
  gdd_name = "gdd",
  cumulative_name = "thermal_time"
)

Arguments

data

Data frame containing temperature observations.

tmin

Minimum-temperature column.

tmax

Maximum-temperature column.

base

Base temperature.

upper

Optional upper threshold.

method

"mean_clamp" or "minmax_clamp".

by

Optional grouping columns for cumulative thermal time.

gdd_name

Output daily GDD column.

cumulative_name

Output cumulative GDD column.

Value

Data frame with daily and cumulative thermal time.

References

McMaster GS, Wilhelm WW (1997). Agricultural and Forest Meteorology 87:291-300. doi:10.1016/S0168-1923(97)00027-0 .

Examples

w <- pheno_data("weather_series")
pheno_thermal_time(w, "tmin", "tmax", base = 10)
